summary: John's 4th great-uncle; brother of Maria Anna; lived with the Meiers in Hazleton in 1880.
bio: In the 1880 census he was 'Bergenmyer, Gabriel, 29, brother-in-law, gardener', sick with 'fever & ague' (a malaria-type fever) on census day, in Friedrich Myer's household — the record that confirms Maria's maiden name. He later moved to Sandusky, Ohio, where brother Joseph lived, and died there 2 Dec 1896.
